announcement.title: 🎬 Cinematic Cut-ins v2.0.2
announcement.content:
v2.0.2: Preset Editing and Automation Fixes

  • Loaded personal and global preset edits no longer appear to revert or overwrite the wrong same-name preset.
  • Turn start and turn end automation can explicitly target Actor: Active Config, while personal and global preset choices remain linked to their reusable source.
  • Editor refresh actions preserve unsaved preset names, group settings, scene scope, and cut-in changes. Newly saved presets also appear immediately in preset and trigger selectors.
